name: V-Core 4 host (3Z) not misdetected as V-Core 3

note: probe_pressure is the required hostname-free discriminator vs a Voron 2.4 (both are QGL/4-Z corexy). Without it, an SV08 correctly stays ambiguous with the Voron 2.4. What it cannot do is tell the base SV08 from the Max: only the bed size separates those, and a volume corroborates without identifying, so the family is pinned and the siblings tie.

note: The family is identified from the load cell, not from the bed size. Base and Max are indistinguishable here, so they tie and the sibling is the runner-up. If one ever pulled ahead it would be on evidence other than the volume, and this assertion is the place that would tell us.

name: led_effect rig with chamber_light must not detect AD5M Pro at >=70
note: A Voron-class rig running the klipper-led_effect mod. The mod's configs target an underlying 'neopixel chamber_light' strip — the most natural chamber-light name on custom builds — and 'chamber_light' contains the AD5M Pro DB pattern 'chamber_l'. That name is generic, so the LED alone must never carry detection to the >=70 high-confidence threshold (where the saved type is overridden / the mismatch warning fires). The unambiguous Voron hardware (QGL + 4x Z steppers) must win, not the LED-name substring match.

name: chamber_light-only rig is never auto-saved
note: Same minimal rig as the #1284 exclusivity test above. #1284 kept it under the 70 warning bar and its comment says it "may still be suggested" - but nothing downstream only-suggested. auto_detect_and_save took the ~55% guess and made it the permanent printer type.

name: unambiguous Voron 2.4 is auto-saved
note: QGL + 4 independent Z steppers is the signature that should have won on the reported rig. Guards the gate against being so strict that a clearly identified printer still falls through to the picker.

name: reported Voron 2.4 rig outscores FlashForge
note: Fingerprint taken from a user's debug bundle: a Voron 2.4 that shipped labelled "FlashForge Adventurer 5M Pro". The capture file records the two things that make it hostile: a hostname that names nothing Voron, and LED section names that contain the AD5M Pro 'chamber_l' pattern.

name: a 500mm Geralkom keeps its own identity
a chamber sensor does not make a Voron a Qidi
note: The reporter's rig: enclosed V0.2 on an RP2040 board, chamber thermistor, no hostname that names anything. The Qidi entries can still corroborate, but none of them may lead. Well clear of the runner-up rather than a coin toss.

name: an identifying volume still needs corroboration
note: The Voron 0 window is the one volume distinctive enough to lead. It must still not identify on its own, or a 120mm cartesian rig becomes a Voron 0 the same way a 500mm Geralkom became a Sovol.

name: reported Voron Trident rig outscores FlashForge
note: Second reporter, different rig, same wrong label: a Voron Trident that shipped as "FlashForge Adventurer 5M Pro". Same hostname blind spot as the QS846GMM rig above, but a different false-positive vector: no led_effect config, just a plain 'output_pin Chamber_Light'. The capture file records the details.
